Pop: Excellent — "lots of pop" and "poppy on take offs" [15][45] 122. Rail performance: Excels on rails and street features; micro-camber locks into rails easily [15][24] 123. Edge hold: Superb — "holds an edge like a knife" — Vario Power Grip sidecut adds extra contact points [44][15] 124. Carving: Noteworthy — responsive edge to edge, fun to carve [15] 125. Switch riding: True twin makes switch riding "a dream" [45] 126. Swing weight: Feels very low — spinning is easy [45] 127. High speed stability: Holds well at high speed with micro camber profile and underfoot stabilisers [44] 128. Buttering: Board presses/butters nicely; nose and tail presses with ease and balance [39][24] 129. Landing forgiveness: Dampening system absorbs flat landings well [45] 130.
